title: UniversalFinder
description: Universal Finder opens a search bar when a Chests, barrels, ender chests, shulkers, hoppers, etc  is opened. it allows you to search any item present in that storage block which helps you to your precious time.
body:
Universal Inventory Search

Find items instantly across supported storage containers with a fast, clean search interface.

Universal Inventory Search lets you search the contents of storage blocks without manually scanning every slot. Simply open a supported container, activate the search, and instantly filter items as you type.

Designed to feel like a natural part of Minecraft while staying lightweight and fast.

✨ Features
🔍 Instant real-time item search
📦 Works with most storage containers
⚡ Fast and lightweight
🎨 Clean, non-intrusive interface
🧩 Fabric compatible
💻 Minecraft 1.21.11
✅ Currently Supported
- Chests
- Double Chests
- Barrels
- Ender Chests
- Shulker Boxes
- Other vanilla storage containers

Note: Player inventory search is not available yet and will be added in a future update.

🚀 Planned Features
🔄 Player inventory search
⭐ Search result highlighting
⚙️ Configurable keybinds
🎨 UI improvements
📦 Better support for modded storage
🚀 Performance optimizations

📖 How to Use
1. Open a supported storage container.
2. click on the search tab above
3. Start typing.
4. Matching items update instantly.

❤️ Feedback
This is the first public release of Universal Inventory Search. If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions for new features, feedback is always appreciated.
